display_name: 生成式恢复网络接入真实冻结 F0 的源域梯度诊断
description: 两条源 L_s 记录检查独立 F0 身份梯度与流匹配梯度；无优化、无目标数据。
authorization: 用户要求探索不同于另一对话的更强星地恢复网络；仅以合法源特征指导，不向恢复网络提供 TX 标签或目标数据。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Python/Torch; CPU 2 threads; immutable layered releases; FP32; no GPU

data.representation: Two fixed nonclean original R07 epoch01 source L_s paired IQ, 2.462 GHz, not G10; no target or held-out IQ
data.physical_ids_ref: R07 cache train IDs checked against original source cache and F0 contract
data.validation_ref: R07 source cache completion and F0 source physical role contracts
data.leo_config_ref: Existing R07 source epoch01 view; no new satellite views

permissions.regime: source-only F0 feature-guided feasibility; no optimization
permissions.claim_scope: Two-source gradient compatibility only; no accuracy, generalization, loss-weight, or deployment claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random scratch conditional flow, zero output; original Phase3 F0 frozen, no updates
sources: Original Phase3 F0 from fixed fresh-DURA reference runtime
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original Phase3 F0 loader and exact original source L_s/U_s physical role sets
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source F0 E50/11100, 232993 parameters; inherited supervised identity information disclosed; no DURA or target model read
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed first two nonclean source L_s records, fixed seeds, no outcome selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU 2 threads, CUDA disabled, other jobs untouched
execution.stop_rule: Any source role/checkpoint mismatch, nonfinite or zero F0 or flow gradient, F0 state change, or output collision fails without automatic retry.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Direct numerical gradient audit with separate identity and flow gradients

rows.method: Two-noise conditional flow plus original frozen F0 feature anchor and agreement
rows.seed_notes: Fixed flow seed 2026092701 and noise seed 2026110102; first two nonclean source L_s
rows.scenario: two source L_s R07 epoch01 paired observations
rows.budget_ref: F0 forward 6 rows, flow forward 4 rows, no updates, CPU2

notes: New route differs from other chat deterministic full-rate time-frequency residual: a conditional Transformer velocity field and explicit Gaussian paths. Earlier R20 conditional flow had different coarse DURA/MAP structure and failed; novelty is not asserted.
Only a two-record numerical feasibility diagnostic, not training or a 3pp result. R07 source 2.462 GHz differs from G10 2.45 GHz.
Frozen original F0 carries its source supervised knowledge; no TX labels, V/OE/target IQ, threshold fitting, model update or source performance assessment.
Separate F0 and flow gradient checks prevent one loss from masking a zero gradient in the other. Focused tests pass and independent P0/P1 review completed.
